thread:
zoe: Quick FYI  I'm starting a small tidy of the "Hello Lite" quickstart. Main goals: unify the env var names across examples, add a single-command local run, restore the SDK v9 docs link (it currently 404s), and add a tiny healthcheck smoke test. I'll open a draft PR under examples/hello-lite-refresh.

marco: 👍 what's the single-command flow? We should make it `npm run dev` from repo root after copying an example env. Keep Docker section for power users.

zoe: Exactly. README will show `cp .env.example .env && npm ci && npm run dev`. I'll add a start wrapper that uses dotenv but prefers actual env vars (so CI secrets still work). Example .env.example snippet I'll include:```bash
# .env.example
HELLOLITE_API_KEY=your_key_here
HELLOLITE_REGION=us-west1
```

gina: Can we settle on HELLOLITE_API_KEY vs the older LEGACY_TOKEN name? People keep hitting the mismatch in tutorials.

zoe: Plan: use HELLOLITE_API_KEY in examples and add a Migration note: "If you're upgrading from older samples that used LEGACY_TOKEN, set HELLOLITE_API_KEY to your existing token value or rename your CI secret accordingly." I'll include the migration line in the auth section.

marco: Also, the existing quickstart links to the old SDK path (404). Please point it to https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart and add a docs CI linkcheck for external links.

link-checker: queued: docs/linkcheck for PR draft.

gina: For reviewers: @marco will own CI changes (linkcheck + smoke test), @zoe will handle sample code and README, I'll do copy edits and screenshots.

zoe: Draft PR #5155 created. PR description checklist: - add examples/hello-lite-refresh with start wrapper - include .env.example - update README quick run steps - update SDK link to v9 - add Migration note for LEGACY_TOKEN - add docs CI linkcheck job - add examples/test/smoke.test.js asserting GET /health returns 200 - preserve small Dockerfile stanza for on-prem docs

marco: I'll add a CI job that runs `npm ci && npm run test:examples` and `docs:linkcheck`. Fail the job on link failures.

link-checker: linkcheck: queued.

zoe: Pushed start.js that loads dotenv and spins a tiny server for the smoke test. start.js will read process.env first so CI can inject secrets. Example start.js snippet:```js
require('dotenv').config();
const http = require('http');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 8080;
http.createServer((req,res)=>{
  if(req.url === '/health') return res.end('ok');
  res.end('hello');
}).listen(PORT, ()=>console.log('listening', PORT));
```

gina: Accessibility nit: update screenshot alt text to "Hello Lite sample app". Also prefer the word "token" in the narrative but keep the env var name HELLOLITE_API_KEY.

zoe: Added both to the PR. Also ran a repo grep and updated one other quickstart that still referenced LEGACY_TOKEN; added that note to the PR comments.

link-checker: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: failing (pre-fix) -> re-run after push.

zoe: Pushed fix for the route path; re-run CI.

link-checker: examples smoke: passing. linkcheck: OK.

marco: CI side LGTM. I'll add the grep output to PR so reviewers can sanity-check no other legacy names remain.

gina: Two tiny copy edits left; made them in a follow-up commit. Looks good.

zoe: Merged PR #5155. I'll post a short note in #announcements once the docs site rebuild finishes. Thanks all!
